fact: A national survey on financial and digital skills by UNCDF, conducted July-August 2025 among 1,601 respondents, was presented in Libreville in May 2026; it finds urban people more skilled than rural.
title: Fracture numérique : seulement 14% de la population rurale connectée à internet
why_not: off-topic: a skills index score from a 1,601-person survey, not a measured share of adults with basic digital skills
